have been registered with this practice for most of my life. I usually attend the Beddau surgery but sometimes need to go to Talbot Green as they usually have more staff working there and a greater choice of appointment times.

You can't book appointments online at either surgery so you have to call first thing in the morning or at 2pm to try to get an appointment or telephone consultation with the doctor for later in the day. You can't usually book appointments with the doctor in advance but usually can for the nurse.

Over the past few months we have experienced a number of problems with our prescriptions. The wait between handing prescriptions in and collecting them from the chemist has gone from 2-3 days to over a week. There have also been occasions when they have provided the wrong items, despite using the repeat prescription request form and clearly marking the medicines.

Most of the time the receptionist are very friendly and helpful but there's occasionally one or two who can be rude and unhelpful. The medical staff are all very professional and always very helpful.

The surgery shares a large car park the shops in the retail park and there are some disabled spaces near the surgery entrance. The car park can get very busy at times so it can be difficult to find a space am extremely disappointed with the service provided by this practice. Patients are instructed to call at 8:00 AM or 2:00 PM to book an appointment, only to be told that the slots are either full or limited to emergency cases. If my condition were truly an emergency, I would have gone to the emergency room instead of contacting the practice.

Furthermore, I fail to understand the reasoning behind limiting appointments to specific hours, rather than allowing patients to schedule in advance at any time. I called at 1:56 PM and was told I must call back at 2:00 PM. Upon doing so, I was informed that my case was not considered an emergency, and I was unable to book an appointment. This system is entirely inefficient and frustrating.

Additionally, the claim that the practice addresses patient concerns within 24 hours is misleading. In reality, patients are forced to wait weeks or even months for an appointment, as it is nearly impossible to book in advance. The practice only offers same-day appointments, which are restricted to either the morning or afternoon—neither of which can be guaranteed to have availability.

To make matters worse, the staff's attitude is consistently rude and disrespectful. It feels as though patients are required to beg for an appointment or even their medication. This is especially concerning given that this practice is involved in training future GPs. It is disheartening to see such a lack of empathy and professionalism in a training environment.

I hope this feedback is taken seriously, as the current system is failing both patients and the
